topic: What is sleep drive? (single): the evening doze
caption:
Dozing on the couch in the evening spends sleep drive right before you need it.

Sleep at any time of day uses up some of the pressure to sleep that builds while you are awake. An evening doze can be part of why bedtime feels wide awake.

From our blog on sleep drive. Full article: link in bio.
